mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO seckill_stock_compensate ( message_id, activity_id, seckill_item_id, user_id, quantity, compensate_type, status ) VALUES ( #{messageId}, #{activityId}, #{seckillItemId}, #{userId}, #{quantity}, #{compensateType}, #{status} )
